name: lanqi-aqua
description: 澜启渔新智慧养殖 Web 管理端、原生鸿蒙 App 与共享设备 API

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @lanqi/api" "npm run dev -w @lanqi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lanqi/web && npm run build -w @lanqi/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lanqi/api && npm run test -w @lanqi/web
scripts.check: npm run check -w @lanqi/web && npm run check -w @lanqi/api
